capabilities: converts chemical formulas like H2O to H₂O
applies conversions on pressing Space in Live Preview
disambiguation: Not a calculator or equation solver; it only rewrites typed notation into symbols.
extras: README is a short pointer; the full usage playbook is in a separate GUIDE.md in the repository.
problem: Typing special math and chemistry symbols in Obsidian means breaking flow to hunt for symbol pickers or hand-write LaTeX.
summary: Converts typed shorthand such as 1/2, H2O and sqrt(x) into fraction, subscript and root symbols when Space is pressed in Live Preview.
